summary: **Coram: Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member** Petition for review of the Commission’s order dated 8.11.2024 in Petition No. 440/GT/ 2020 pertaining to the approval of tariff of Kahalgaon Super Thermal Power Station, Stage-I (840 MW) for the period 2019-24. 1. Bihar State Power (Holding) Company Limited, _(erstwhile Bihar State Electricity Board)_ Vidyut Bhawan, Bailey Road, Patna- 800 021 _Order in Petition No. 4/RP/2025 in Petition No. 440/GT/2020 Page_ **_1_** _of 5_ 8. Uttar Pradesh Power Corp. Ltd. (UPPCL) Shakti Bhawan, 14, Ashok Marg, Lucknow - 226001 Shri Venkatesh, Advocate, NTPC Ms. Surbhi Kapoor, Advocate, NTPC Ms. Ananya Sinha, Advocate, NTPC Shri Vijendra Singh, NTPC Shri Rahul Kinra, Advocate, BRPL & BYPL Shri Aditya Ajay, Advocate, BRPL & BYPL Shri Anand Kumar Shrivastava, Advocate, BSPHCL Shri Shivam Sinha, Advocate, BSPHCL Shri Ravi Nair, Advocate, BSPHCL Shri Rishabh Dua, Advocate, BSPHCL Shri Mudassir, Advocate, BSPHCL Petition No.440/GT/2020 was filed by the Petitioner, NTPC Limited, for approval of tariff of Kahalgaon Super Thermal Power Station, Stage-I (840 MW) (in short, ‘the generating station’) for the period 2019-24, in accordance with the provisions of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms & Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 (in short ‘the 2019 Tariff Regulations’) and the Commission vide order dated _Order in Petition No. 4/RP/2025 in Petition No. 440/GT/2020 Page_ **_2_** _of 5_ 8.11.2024 (in short, ‘the impugned order’) disposed of the said petition. Aggrieved by the impugned order dated 8.11.2024, the Review Petitioner has filed this Review Petition, on the ground that there is an error apparent on the face of the record, on the following issue: _Order in Petition No. 4/RP/2025 in Petition No. 440/GT/2020 Page_ **_3_** _of 5_ in the impugned order for Units-1, 3 and 4. Accordingly, the Review Petitioner has argued that Units-1, 3 and 4 of the generating station are eligible for the Special Allowance from the date of completion of the useful life in terms of the 2019 Tariff Regulations, and not from the next financial year, as calculated by the Commission in the impugned order for the Units-1, 3 and 4. Thus, the Review Petitioner has prayed that the Commission may rectify the error and allow the Special Allowance for the generating station as claimed by it in the main petition. 3. During the hearing of the Review Petition ‘on admission’ on 18.9.2025, the learned counsel for the Review Petitioner made oral submissions, as above, in support of its prayer for rectification of the error apparent in the impugned order. However, on a specific query by the Commission, as to why the issue raised herein, should not be considered in the truing-up petition (Petition No.792/GT/2025) filed by the Review Petitioner in respect of this generating station for the period 2019-24, and pending for consideration of the Commission, the learned counsel for the Review Petitioner submitted that the Commission may grant liberty to the Review Petitioner to claim the same in the aforesaid truing-up petition filed for the period 2019-24. This request was _Order in Petition No. 4/RP/2025 in Petition No. 440/GT/2020 Page_ **_4_** _of 5_ also not objected to by the learned counsel for the Respondents appearing in the matter. 4. In view of the above, the Review Petitioner is permitted to raise the issue of calculation of special allowance for the period 2019-24 (as in para 1 above) in the truing-up petition (792/GT/2025) filed by the Review Petitioner, in respect of the generating station for the period 2019-24, and the same will be considered in accordance with law. We also direct the Review Petitioner to submit, in the truing-up petition, an affidavit detailing the actual expenses incurred up to 31.3.2024, out of the Special Allowance granted to the generating station for the period 2019-24. 5. The prayer of the Review Petitioner, in the Petition No. 4/RP/2025 (in Petition No. 440/GT/2020) stands disposed of in terms of the above. _Order in Petition No. 4/RP/2025 in Petition No. 440/GT/2020 Page_ **_5_** _of 5_ CERC Website S. No. 622/2025
